translations.web: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
translations.bsb: The hope of the righteous is joy, but the expectations of the wicked will perish.
translations.kjv: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
